_comment: rent-watch criteria. JSON, not YAML — ruled 2026-08-07 (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q22). JSON has no comments, so any key beginning with an underscore is ignored by the loader; EVERY other unrecognised key is a hard error, which is what stops this convention from swallowing a typo. Values here were already public in prototype/sources.yaml — nothing personal is added. For private tuning, copy this to config/criteria.local.json (gitignored); it overrides field by field.
_communes: Hard filter, ruled 2026-08-07 (Q1). Boucle de Seine. Matched on the listing's COMMUNE FIELD only, never as a substring of the description — the prototype searched the description too, so a Paris listing saying 'proche Chatou' passed. Adding a neighbour is one line here plus one line in commune_rank.
_postcode_prefixes: AND with `communes`, not OR. Every commune above is in 78 or 95, so this can never admit anything the commune list does not — its job is to reject a same-named commune elsewhere in France. Prefix 92 was REMOVED on 2026-08-07: it could not match anything, so it read as intent it did not have. A listing with no postcode is NOT disqualified — unknown is not wrong (hard rule 9).
_min_rooms: Pièces, not chambres. T4, ruled 2026-08-07 (Q3). An UNKNOWN room count does not disqualify — that is the prototype's `(l.rooms or 0) < min_rooms` bug, which rejects every listing that did not state a room count.
_max_rent_cc: CHARGES COMPRISES, hard cutoff, ruled 2026-08-07 (Q2). Every source is normalised to CC before comparison; a source that reports hors charges must declare `charges_included: false` in sources.json so the charges can be added. A listing whose CC rent cannot be determined is not disqualified — it loses the rent-headroom score component instead, and says so in its reasons.
_exclude_patterns: Property KIND and letting KIND, never tenure. Tenure exclusion lives in Tenure::isExcluded() and is deliberately absent from config: a user-editable regex duplicating CLAUDE.md §1 would be a second, weaker copy of the one guarantee that must not be config-overridable. Patterns are PCRE fragments matched case-insensitively against ACCENT-FOLDED text, so write `meuble`, not `meublé` — the loader refuses an accented pattern rather than letting it silently never match. Matched against title AND description.
_exclude_title_patterns: Matched against the TITLE ONLY, and that is the point. `parking`, `box`, `garage`, `cave` and `bureau` are property types in a title and ordinary amenities in a description — 'T4 avec parking' is wanted, 'Parking en sous-sol' is not. Matching these against the description would drop every flat that has a parking space; not matching them at all would let a parking ad through, because a parking ad states no rooms and no surface and an unknown measurement is never a disqualification. Most are anchored at the start of the title, which is where a property type sits — but not all, and that is deliberate. While EVERY pattern was anchored, the title-only scope protected nothing a sabotage could disprove: a `^` with no `m` flag cannot match inside an appended description either way, so widening the scope was a semantic no-op and the guarantee was untestable. The unanchored entries are phrases unambiguous wherever they sit in a title (`loue parking`, `emplacement de stationnement`) and ordinary in a description ('emplacement de stationnement inclus'), which gives the scope something real to protect.
_commune_rank: 1 = most wanted. Drives score component S1 only; it never filters. Every ranked commune must also appear in `communes`, and the loader refuses a rank for one that does not — a rank on a filtered-out commune is dead config.
_weights: spec/PROJECT_BRIEF.md §5, weights ruled 2026-08-07. Normalised, so a disabled component does not silently depress every score by its share. `high_floor_no_lift` is the one weight that must be negative, and it is excluded from the normalising total: a penalty is subtracted from what a listing earned, not part of what it could earn.
_commute: Off until an IDFM/PRIM key exists (Q1). The loader refuses `enabled: true` with a commute weight of 0, and refuses a non-zero weight while disabled — either way the score would misreport. Turning it on means: set enabled, name the station, set max_minutes, and give weights.commute a value.
_freshness_minutes: A listing first seen within this window earns the full freshness bonus (S7). The brief notes good LLI units go within hours.
_notify: Routing, ruled 2026-08-07. Nothing is batched: the premise of the whole tool is that good stock goes within hours. `channels` ships as console only, because a channel needing a credential cannot be the default in a repo whose .env is not filled in — enabling ntfy or email without its credential is a startup refusal, never a silent no-op.
